# The yaml-test-suite cases (testdata/yaml-test-suite, data-2022-01-17) that
# angzarr-yaml does not pass, one per line: `<case> <how>: <why>`. <how> is
# `refused` (a valid case the reader refuses), `misread` (a valid case read
# as another value) or `accepts-invalid` (an invalid case read as a value).
# Every other case passes. src/conformance.test.rs holds the list to the
# run: a listed case that passes, or fails another way, and an unlisted one
# that fails, fail it. Take a case off when it passes; never add one to get
# a change through without saying why here.
#
# This reader is a strict subset (lib.rs): directives, multiple documents,
# anchors, aliases, tags, explicit keys, collection or null keys, quoted
# scalars over several lines and some block scalar headers are refused by
# design. The misread and accepts-invalid rows are leniencies, known and
# kept here until fixed.
4ABK misread: a flow mapping key ends at its first `:`, so the key `http://foo.com` is read as `http` with the value `//foo.com`
M2N8/00 misread: an explicit key (`- ? : x`) is read as the key `?`
M2N8/01 misread: an explicit key (`? []: x`) is read as the key `? []`
WZ62 misread: a tag inside a flow collection (`!!str`) is read as text, not refused
Y79Y/010 misread: a tab after a dash (`-\t-1`) is no separation here: the line is read as the text `-\t-1`, not an item
5LLU accepts-invalid: a block scalar's leading lines of spaces deeper than its first content line are taken as empty, not refused
9MMA accepts-invalid: a directive alone (`%YAML 1.2`) is read as plain text: `%` cannot start a plain scalar in YAML
CML9 accepts-invalid: a comment between the lines of a plain scalar in a flow collection is skipped, not refused
S98Z accepts-invalid: a block scalar's leading lines of spaces deeper than its first content line are taken as empty, not refused
VJP3/00 accepts-invalid: a flow collection's lines at its parent's indent are joined, not refused
Y79Y/000 accepts-invalid: a block scalar's line of a tab alone is taken as empty, not refused
Y79Y/004 accepts-invalid: a tab after a dash (`-\t-`) is read as text, not refused
Y79Y/005 accepts-invalid: a tab before an indicator (`- \t-`) is read as text, not refused
Y79Y/006 accepts-invalid: a tab after `?` (`?\t-`) is read as text, not refused
Y79Y/008 accepts-invalid: a tab after `?` (`?\tkey:`) is read as a key, not refused
YJV2 accepts-invalid: a dash alone in a flow sequence (`[-]`) is read as text, not refused
ZCZ6 accepts-invalid: `a: b: c: d` is read as the text `b: c: d`; YAML ends a plain scalar at `: `
26DV refused: an alias (*): not supported
27NA refused: a directive (%YAML, %TAG): directives are not supported
2AUY refused: a tag (!): not supported
2G84/02 refused: content on a document marker line (`--- text`), which this reader does not strip
